functions.label: Open the board list
functions.detail: The signed-in list of boards and tasks finishes loading.

functions.label: Open a board
functions.detail: A real board returns its task and column data and renders on desktop and mobile.

functions.detail: A real task returns its data and its detail view renders on desktop and mobile.

functions.label: Load task comments
functions.detail: The comment list returns usable data for a real task.

functions.label: Post a comment
functions.detail: A comment saves and appears when the task is read again.

functions.detail: The move menu receives both columns needed for the check.

functions.label: Move a task to another column
functions.detail: The task moves, the activity appears, and the check restores the original column.

functions.label: Assign and unassign a person
functions.detail: Both assignment changes persist and the check restores the task.

functions.label: Search for a task
functions.detail: Search returns the known task and the signed-in search screen renders.

functions.label: Open notifications
functions.detail: The signed-in inbox finishes loading on desktop and mobile.

functions.label: Open the calendar
functions.detail: The signed-in calendar renders on desktop and mobile.

functions.label: Open settings
functions.detail: The signed-in settings screen renders on desktop and mobile.

functions.label: Open the new-task form
functions.detail: The signed-in new-task form renders on desktop and mobile.

functions.label: Create a task on the demo board
functions.detail: The public demo saves a new task and shows it on the board.

functions.label: Open the login screen
functions.detail: The public login screen renders. It does not complete a login.

functions.label: Open the marketing page
functions.detail: The public landing page renders its main heading and actions.

functions.label: Validate and save attachment uploads
functions.detail: Automated code tests cover upload receipts, file limits, and attachment links.

functions.label: Save and mark notifications
functions.detail: Automated code tests cover notification access and seen state.

functions.label: Complete a real login
functions.detail: No browser check submits a login and proves the account opens.

functions.label: Create a task while signed in
functions.detail: The form opens, but no live signed-in check submits and reloads the new task.

functions.label: Attach a file in the browser
functions.detail: Code tests cover upload rules, but no live browser check uploads and reopens a file.

functions.label: Receive a new notification
functions.detail: The inbox loads, but no live check triggers and receives a notification.

functions.label: See a change from another session
functions.detail: No automated check opens two signed-in sessions and proves live updates arrive.

functions.label: Receive a reminder
functions.detail: No live browser check schedules a reminder and proves it arrives.

functions.label: Get an answer from the AI assistant
functions.detail: No live browser check sends an AI request because that spends money and changes data.
